meaning.en: The act of searing some morbid part by the application of a cautery or caustic; also, the effect of such application.
meaning.vi: Hành động làm đau nhức một số bộ phận bệnh tật bằng cách sử dụng keo hoặc xút; ngoài ra, tác dụng của ứng dụng đó.

sentences.en: Vigorous cauterization with nitrate of silver, driving the stick into the widened wound, is also good, and it is a remedy which one can carry in the pocket.

sentences.en: The doctor uses the camera to locate the fallopian tubes, then cuts the tubes and either seals them with clips or uses a technique called cauterization to close the ends by burning them.

sentences.en: Conclusion: Trichloroacetic acid cauterization and local application of MEBO is markedly effective for treating pharyngeal fistula.
